title: Contested, no settling event soon
trigger: Third-quarter 10-Q filed: revenue growth missed the 20% checkpoint.

thesis.summary: Transformer maker benefiting from federal grid spending; revenue growth above 20% with stable margins.

chunks.text: Revenue for the third quarter increased 14% compared with the prior-year quarter. Growth was reduced by a shortage of grain-oriented electrical steel used in our transformer cores, which delayed shipments. Management expects the component shortage to continue for the next two quarters.

Backlog increased 9% to a record level. Approximately 40% of backlog depends on utility projects funded under the federal Grid Resilience Program, so the timing of federal disbursements directly affects when revenue is recognized.
Gross margin declined to 27.5% from 31.0% in the prior quarter, primarily due to expedited freight and spot purchases of electrical steel made to mitigate the shortage.
We depend on a limited number of suppliers for electrical steel. A prolonged shortage of electrical steel could reduce our margins and delay deliveries to utility customers.

Gridworks reports third quarter results. Chief executive: our quarter was affected by temporary delays in federal grid funding. Demand remains strong and we expect growth to return once funding resumes.

Proposed rule: the Department of Energy proposes a revised disbursement schedule for the Grid Resilience Program, deferring a portion of fiscal year 2027 funding to fiscal year 2028. Comments are due December 15, 2026.
Revenue increased 24% compared with the prior-year quarter. We have adequate supply of electrical steel and no supply constraints on transformer production.
Revenue for the third quarter decreased 6%. Demand from utility customers weakened and a shortage of electrical steel delayed transformer shipments for the next two quarters.

analyst.recommend.explanation: Revenue grew 14%, below the 20% checkpoint, and gross margin fell to 27.5% because of an electrical steel shortage that management expects to last two quarters. Trim the position and tighten the stop while the shortage plays out.
analyst.recommend.falsifier: Fourth-quarter gross margin recovers above the prior quarter
